note: Budget for `node scripts/consumer-size.mjs --check` (CI, P8): the cost, minified + gzip, of a Vue app built from each fixture in tests/fixtures/consumer (the Vue package, the core and the protocol bundled), minus the same app without the console (tests/fixtures/consumer/vue-only.ts). `measuredGzipBytes` is the value when the budget was last set; `maxGzipBytes` is that plus 5%, rounded up, capped at `ceilingGzipBytes` when one is set. A deliberate growth raises the budget (and the ceiling when needed) in the same change, with a one-line reason in `history`.
history: 0.0.0 (tooling, #1, 2026-10-26): first measurement on the empty packages. Each fixture imports the Vue package as a namespace and renders its export names, so the cost is the fixture's own code; the Vue piece replaces the fixtures with the composable and the component and sets the budgets from their first measure.

0.0.0 (vue, #1, 2026-10-26): the fixtures become real use: `composable` draws its own markup from useCommandConsole (core features only), `component` renders <CommandConsole> with v-model:entries (recall, completion and context included).

1.0.1 (core, #13, 2026-11-04): the core bundles the schema line, the gate path and request() (with their protocol code: parseOptions, validateInput, formatCommandLine, checkInputSchema, parseEnvelope), about 4.6 KB in both fixtures.

1.2.0 (core, #13, 2026-11-04): a response's `data` reaches request()'s outcome, read once inside a guard (isJsonValue, one JSON.stringify with a replacer, a UTF-8 byte count, a copy parsed from that text), about 100 B in both fixtures; the component was 30 B over the old budget after shortening.

1.3.0 (core, #13, 2026-11-05): an error outcome says what to fix (the schema's refusal in words with the nearest known field, a CommandError's message), a string for a list of strings, a summary function; about 850 B in both fixtures. The component stays within its budget, so only the composable's is raised.

1.4.0 (core, #13, 2026-11-05): a not-allowed outcome says why and gives a change command's line, and the console validates and reads namespace summaries (namespaces, getNamespaces); about 415 B in both fixtures (composable 11893 → 12308 B). The component goes over its budget, so its budget is raised; the composable stays within its own.
